user.title: Empower electricity
user.description: Receives one electricity meter from the Empower Browser app running on Home Assistant OS. Timestamp settings interpret a continuous sequence of 15-minute elapsed intervals. Historical Energy import starts disabled. Check the graph and timezone before enabling it.

data.timestamp_label: Timestamps mark interval start or end

error.invalid_timezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, for example America/Chicago.

abort.already_configured: This single-meter integration is already configured.

init.title: Historical Energy import
init.description: Enable only after confirming kWh units, start/end labels, the configured timezone, and that readings are consecutive 15-minute elapsed intervals across daylight-saving changes. Re-upload after enabling. Disabling stops future imports but does not delete statistics already stored.

data.import_statistics: I have verified the timestamp and kWh assumptions; import Energy history
